Question: Can a police officer keep pulling you over for not having a license?
Answer: Yup. If they know you don’t have a valid license, they can pull you over any time they see you driving a car. And they can give you a ticket every time they do. Your best option is to get your license sorted out and legal. It is fair to say that there is a larger discussion to be held about how easy it is to have your licenses suspended or revoked in some parts of the US and how that often times makes life impossible for the person who is thusly suspended. But if you have your license suspended that means you can’t drive.
